name: La Mesa Farmers' Market
location: Date St. and Allison St., CA
description: La Mesa Farmers' Market is a farmers market in Date St. and Allison St., CA, bringing together local growers, bakers, and makers. Shoppers can find seasonal produce, baked goods, and artisan products from area farms. Check the website for current hours and availability.
Seasonal availability typically runs from Mar – Jun in this growing zone.
